evaluationCaveats: Neural head accuracies and hybrid semantic-parser metrics are separate measurements. The 100% semantic result applies only to these controlled templates, not arbitrary language.
Mode head is conditioned on the active workspace, so 100% mode accuracy measures consistency.

Numeric ground truth is authored independently; some single-target labels are parser-derived. Target accuracy measures single-target context rows and does not establish general multi-target language accuracy.
The shipped model is trained on 2,548 rows. The separate 100K run repeats a small dataset to measure capacity and responsiveness; it adds no linguistic knowledge.

guarantees.inference: All inference, training and execution are local. No cloud AI APIs or external intelligence dependency.
guarantees.context: Snapshots are read-only data and never executed as commands.
guarantees.queries: Read-only FIND/CHECK/COMPARE/COUNT commands emit no creation effects. Live midpoint, distance, intersection and root tests verified unchanged object counts.
guarantees.corrections: Up to 5,000 full semantic corrections, migrated from legacy storage without whole-model retraining.

limitations: Specialized 3D plane constructions, advanced centers, grouping/shear/camera operations and other unsupported registry entries fail explicitly.
Graph roots/intersections use bounded numerical search [-100,100]; tangencies and closely spaced roots can be missed.
Native 2D geometry and Robo-created 3D/graph objects are inventoried; some built-in 3D objects and manually entered graph layers are not exposed to target resolution.
Undo/redo covers semantic assistant operations; existing gesture and renderer workflows retain their own history.
Normal embedded mode retains the existing v3 assistant compatibility path.
IndexedDB models and corrections are browser/origin-specific. Download model.json, weights.bin, labels.json and metadata.json for portability.
